title: Joseph Smith possibly killed by government agents, and the state of Deseret
summary: Matthew Pines tells of Joseph Smith possibly killed by government agents, and the state of Deseret, about 1840s at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Joseph Smith actually may have been assassinated by agents of the government.

plain: Matthew Pines, a researcher, says on Jesse Michels's podcast that Joseph Smith, the founder of the Mormon church, "may have been assassinated by agents of the government" in the 1840s. The story also touches on Deseret, the name Mormon settlers gave to their own proposed state in what is now Utah. If true, the US government would have secretly killed a religious founder.
